decisions.rule: Exchange-attributed wallet totals are not customer liabilities, tradable float or order-book liquidity. Separate wrapped reserves, charity/insurance, Binance US and other non-customer balances; preserve source rounding and same-wallet methodology.

Record live explorer balances with capture time and label provider. Do not treat an explorer label as official PoR membership. Keep source-wallet residual balances, attacker receiver holdings and later internal sweeps separate.
A rounded aggregate decline close to a theft amount is a reconciliation lead only. Do not assign causality without per-wallet history, stable wallet-set identity and official address-file crosswalk.
Coinbase or SBI VC Trade aggregate balance changes do not establish customer migration or lending volume. Require account/product-level public evidence before making those causal claims.
